rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an inherited cultural tradition.

example.english: Celebrating Lunar New Year this way is a tradition passed down in our family.
example.traditional: 農曆新年咁過係我哋一家代代相傳嘅傳統。
example.jyutping: nung4 lik6 san1 nin4 gam2 gwo3 hai6 ngo5 dei6 jat1 gaa1 doi6 doi6 soeng1 cyun4 ge3 cyun4 tung2

rows.note: Use this for a customary practice, especially one associated with festivals or a particular community.

example.english: Eating rice dumplings at the Dragon Boat Festival is a local tradition here.
example.traditional: 端午節食糭係呢度嘅習俗。
